about:
Tri-Fab Steel, Inc. was founded in 1971 in Birmingham, Alabama. The company began with approximately 8,000 square feet of manufacturing space and has since expanded to over 80,000 square feet.

The shop specializes in heavy industrial fabrication using carbon steel and stainless steel. Its capabilities include structural steel fabrication, as well as bins, ducts, and hoppers. Tri-Fab works from customer design drawings to produce shop details, erection prints, and all necessary hardware for complete installations. Projects typically range from a few tons up to 150 tons. The facility is equipped with overhead cranes in every bay and a Hyd-Mech 16-inch CNC band saw with power feed, among other fabrication equipment.

Tri-Fab serves a variety of industrial customers, though specific sectors are not detailed in its public materials. The company describes its clientele as an array of different types, focusing on heavy industrial applications.

Tri-Fab emphasizes that its well-equipped shop, combined with experienced personnel, enables it to meet most fabrication requirements. The business was built to provide complete installation packages from design through hardware supply.
